name: Table 97: Grinding Complications
description: Rulebook Table 97 (p.531), Floor 5: The Bubbles, the Yard (Grass Jungle / Desert Sandbox quadrant). Random complications for crawlers grinding for experience against Spiders, Snakes, Beetles, and Gerbils in the toy-strewn Yard.

results.name: Wolf Spider herds crawlers toward its web
results.description: A Wolf Spider begins hunting the crawlers through tall grass. It's toying with them, herding them toward an area of the yard dense with webs, where they are cornered.

results.name: Spider-riding Gerbil defectors demand tribute
results.description: The crawlers come across a group of nomadic Gerbils who defected from their kingdom. They each tamed a small Spider and use them as mounts. They demand the crawlers turn over all food and weapons, attacking if refused.

results.name: Bonneted Trapdoor Spider vendor
results.description: A Trapdoor Spider wearing a bonnet pops out of her burrow with a flourish. She's a vendor selling various spider-themed items.

results.name: Gigantic cookie swarmed by insects
results.description: The party comes across a gigantic cookie on the ground, towering over the area. A horde of insects surrounds it, tearing off chunks. If the crawlers linger, a territorial group of Beetles attack to protect their meal.

results.name: Water Snake digesting a familiar crawler
results.description: A Nerodia Water Snake writhes on the ground, body distending oddly as it thrashes. The lump inside seems to be moving. It's eaten a crawler the party met before, and the unfortunate victim is trying to escape being digested.

results.name: Tide of battling insects and a Snake
results.description: The crawlers hear the shouts and clatter of combat approaching, animalistic noises and the dull thud of limbs pounding one another resound through the clearing. A tide of Gerbils, Mantises, Beetles, Spiders, and a Snake locked in a battle quickly envelop them.
